title: Video captures car exploding in this infamous Minnesota tunnel
description:
Full thread here with details: https://twitter.com/MN_CRIME/status/1383974633515278339?s=20

"The BMW attempted to enter the Lowry Hill Tunnel westbound, at a high rate of speed. The BMW struck the freeway barrier wall, rupturing the fuel tank. It came to a final rest inside the tunnel. The BMW had three occupants, two died at the scene and one was transported with life threatening injuries.

Vehicle: 2007 BMW 750
